ENGLISH STATESMEN.—TWELVE ENGLISH STATESMEN. Crown 8vo. 2s. 6d. each.

Under the above title Messrs. Macmillan & Co. are now publishing a series of short biographies, not designed to be a complete roll of famous Statesmen, but to present in historic order the lives and work of those leading actors in our affairs who by their direct influence have left an abiding mark on the policy, the institutions, and the position of Great Britain among States.
